A 94 , 062113(2016) and Phys. Rev. A 95 , 052111(2017)], is applied to elementary concepts of quantum information like qubits and 2-qubits, e.g., entangled EPR/Bell states etc..

arxiv-2302-10947.title: Using helium 10830 Å transits to constrain planetary magnetic fields 2015 Using helium 10830 Å transits to constrain planetary magnetic fields – B.2
arxiv-2302-10947.creator: Ethan Schreyer, James E. Owen, Jessica J. Spake, Zahra Bahroloom, Simone Di Giampasquale
arxiv-2302-10947.description: Abstract Planetary magnetic fields can affect the predicted mass loss rate for close-in planets that experience large amounts of UV irradiation. In this work, we present a method to detect the magnetic fields of close-in exoplanets undergoing atmospheric escape using transit spectroscopy at the 10830 Å line of helium.

arxiv-2401-13973.title: Optimal design of unimorph-type cantilevered piezoelectric energy harvesters using level set-based topology optimization by considering manufacturability
arxiv-2401-13973.creator: Ken Miyajima, Takayuki Yamada
arxiv-2401-13973.description: Abstract In this study, we propose a design methodology for a piezoelectric energy-harvesting device optimized for maximal power generation at a designated frequency using topology optimization. The proposed methodology is adapted to the design of a unimorph-type piezoelectric energy harvester, wherein a piezoelectric film is affixed to a singular side of a silicon cantilever beam.

arxiv-2403-19429.title: Transport properties through alternating borophene and graphene superlattices
arxiv-2403-19429.creator: Nadia Benlakhouy, Abderrahim El Mouhafid, Ahmed Jellal
arxiv-2403-19429.description: Abstract The electronic transport properties of two junctions (BGB, GBG) made of borophene (B) and graphene (G) are investigated. Using the transfer matrix method with Chebyshev polynomials, we have studied single and multiple barriers in a superlattice configuration. We showed that a single barrier exhibits remarkable tilted transport properties, with perfect transmission observed for both junctions under normal incidence.

arxiv-2412-15193.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sören Wengerowsky ∗†, Stefano Duranti ∗, Lukas Heller, Hugues de Riedmatten ‡. Quantum Frequency Conversion (QFC) is a widely used technique to interface atomic systems with the telecom band in order to facilitate propagation over longer distances in fiber. Here we demonstrate the difference-frequency conversion from 606 nm 606\text{\,}\mathrm{nm} to 1552 nm 1552\text{\,}\mathrm{nm} of microsecond-long weak coherent pulses at the single photon level compatible with Pr 3+ :Y 2 SiO 5 {}_{5}\, quantum memories, with high-signal to noise ratio.

arxiv-2506-22548.title: Constraining Cubic Curvature Corrections to General Relativity with Quasi-Periodic Oscillations
arxiv-2506-22548.creator: Alireza Allahyari
arxiv-2506-22548.description: Abstract YITP-25-92, IPMU25-0031 We investigate observational constraints on cubic curvature corrections to general relativity by analyzing quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) in accreting black hole systems. In particular, we study Kerr black hole solution corrected by cubic curvature terms parameterized by \beta_{5} and \beta_{6} .

pmc-10622435.creator: Wenjiang Yu, Chengyan Liu, Zhiguo Bi
pmc-10622435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). With the aging of the population, an increasing number of elderly patients are opting for artificial joint replacement, leading to the exploration of various rapid rehabilitation programs in the perioperative period. In this study, we aimed to investigate the effectiveness of combining recombinant human erythropoietin and iron sucrose in altering the range and trend of postoperative hemoglobin in patients undergoing arthroplasty.

pmc-11353187.title: Decidualized Endometrial Stromal Cells Promote Mitochondrial Beta-Oxidation to Produce the Octanoic Acid Required for Implantation
pmc-11353187.creator: Yumi Mizuno, Shunsuke Tamaru, Hideno Tochigi, Tomomi Sato, Miyuko Kishi, Akira Ohtake, Osamu Ishihara, Takeshi Kajihara
pmc-11353187.description: Decidualization denotes the morphological and biological differentiating process of human endometrial stromal cells (HESCs). Fatty acid pathways are critical for endometrial decidualization. However, the participation of fatty acids as an energy source and their role in endometrial decidualization have received little attention.

pmc-11510496.title: Bacillus subtilis Strain YJ-15, Isolated from the Rhizosphere of Wheat Grown under Saline Conditions, Increases Soil Fertility and Modifies Microbial Community Structure
pmc-11510496.creator: Junkang Sui, Chenyu Wang, Pengfei Chu, Changqing Ren, Feifan Hou, Yuxuan Zhang, Xueting Shang, Qiqi Zhao, Xuewen Hua, Hengjia Zhang, Michael F Hynes
pmc-11510496.description: Soil salinization during wheat cultivation considerably diminishes soil fertility and impedes wheat growth, primarily due to rhizosphere microbial community changes. Our study investigates the application of Bacillus subtilis YJ-15, a strain isolated from the rhizosphere of wheat cultivated in salinized soil, as a soil remediation agent.

pmc-11526556.title: Epidemiology, clinical features, and outcome of the hospitalized patients with Kerion in Fars Province, Iran: an eleven-year retrospective study
pmc-11526556.creator: Fateme Khosravi, Mohammad Mahdi Parvizi, Maryam Sadat Sadati, Mohammadreza Khosravi, Mehdi Ghahartars
pmc-11526556.description: BackgroundKerion, a severe inflammatory type of tinea capitis, presents with purulent, boggy swelling and alopecia. Few articles in the literature provide information on this uncommon manifestation of tinea capitis (TC). This study aimed to determine the epidemiological and clinical characteristics of patients with Kerion over an 11-year period in an inpatient setting.

pmc-12514792.title: Modelling the determinants of uptake of complete immunization of children in Ghana
pmc-12514792.creator: Daudi Yeboah, Gideon Mensah Engmann, Dioggban Jakperik
pmc-12514792.description: Immunization remains a vital public health initiative for children since it reduces the risk of morbidity, mortality, and long-term complications associated with vaccine-preventable diseases. The study sought to model the determinants of uptake of complete immunization among children in Ghana using data from the 2022 Ghana Demographic and Health Survey (GDHS).

pmc-12649272.title: How Employees’ Emotional Labor Promotes Perceived Service Quality: A Dual-Pathway Model
pmc-12649272.creator: Pengfei Cheng, Xu Zhao
pmc-12649272.description: Although service firms recognize the significance of frontline employees’ emotional labor in enhancing perceived service quality and sustaining competitive advantage, the theoretical mechanisms underlying this relationship remain insufficiently understood. Drawing on the Emotions as Social Information Model (EASI), this study proposed that frontline employees’ emotional labor influences customer perceived service quality through two distinct pathways: emotional contagion and inferential processing.

pmc-13498314.title: Hyperuricaemia-Induced Hypertension in Rats by Regulating the RhoA/ROCK Pathway
pmc-13498314.creator: Yan Zhang, Zhongchao Wang, Yinli Xu, Nan Wang, Zihua Xu, Tianshu Ren, Qingchun Zhao, Weihong Meng
pmc-13498314.description: IntroductionHyperuricaemia (HUA) is associated with hypertension, but the mechanisms remain unclear. This study investigated whether the RhoA/ROCK pathway mediates HUA-induced vascular remodelling and hypertension.MethodsThirty male Sprague-Dawley rats were divided into control, HUA, and fasudil (ROCK inhibitor) groups. Serum uric acid, creatinine, and blood pressure were measured biweekly. Histopathology, qPCR, and Western blotting assessed thoracic aortic changes and RhoA/ROCK pathway activation.
